name: @wildflowerhealthio/fhir-r4-adoption
description: The FHIR R4 side of extraction: how a resource decoded from a source becomes the device's own — adoptResource keys it under a local id derived from the source's identity and rewrites its references, DecodedId is the id it is adopted under (the source's own, or one generated from its content when the source gave none), and adoptUnderRecognizedRoot adopts every resource a response kind parses under the identity its tryRecognize mints. No DOM, no fs, no React.
